value.rationale: A natural, infinite, critical polygon-Rips family has every possible finite cyclic first homology group after its canonical full rotational quotient, despite each original being a torsion-free simply connected wedge of 2-spheres. The exact Moore-space and fundamental-group identification distinguish geometric quotient from metric quotient and have genuine structural topological motivation.
